name: Craft Designs of the World
subtitle: Tanghua, Wire car & more
shortDescription: 8 craft traditions to play: Karesansui gravel garden, Kisii soapstone carving, Lost-wax bronze casting and Rishtan ceramics.
longDescription:
Craft Designs of the World: 8 craft traditions from 10 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Karesansui gravel garden, Kisii soapstone carving, Lost-wax bronze casting, Rishtan ceramics, Tanghua, Tessellated mosaic making, Wire car and Zellij tile mosaic.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can build traditional patterns and make traditional crafts, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
